name: knowthankyew-extension
description: Zero-egress, client-side browser reality engine detecting predatory subscription traps, arbitration waivers, and dark patterns in real-time

scripts.package: npm run build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*" -x "__MACOSX*") && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}.zip > SHA256SUMS
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist-firefox && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}-firefox.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*" -x "__MACOSX*") && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}*.zip > SHA256SUMS
scripts.package:safari: npm run build:safari && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist-safari && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}-safari.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*" -x "__MACOSX*") && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}*.zip > SHA256SUMS
scripts.package:all: npm run package && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:safari && VITE_LOCAL_ML_ENABLED=true vite build && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && (cd dist && zip -r ../knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}-local-assist.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*" -x "__MACOSX*") && npm run build && shasum -a 256 knowthankyew-extension-v${VERSION}*.zip > SHA256SUMS
